provenance: Fixed reconstruction from the operator facts recorded in docs/plans/progress/e2e-30aug.md; the preserved source does not contain the original seven answer texts, so this is not a verbatim transcript. The boundary answer is stated generically and does not name the systems the out-of-scope tasks probe.
transcript:
DAY0: 1/7 — Why this hire? What triggered the decision to bring me on? What's the team trying to make easier?
BOSS: Relieve the RevOps backlog and make the revenue forecast credible. We need a documentation-grounded ops teammate who closes bounded work without inventing figures.
DAY0: 2/7 — The role itself. What do you see me doing day-to-day? What should months 1, 2 and 3 look like?
BOSS: Read internal documentation and answer evidence-backed questions. Maintain the Q4 revenue tracker, update RevOps tickets, and send bounded RevOps handoff or verification messages in Slack. Draft and execute only the literal requested change after my approval. By day 30, learn the docs and propose work; by day 60, handle bounded ticket, sheet and Slack tasks with supervision; by day 90, be trusted on repeatable RevOps work while escalating exceptions.
DAY0: 3/7 — Who should I talk to? Who should I meet first, and who makes the introduction?
BOSS: Meet Priya about analytics dependencies, Aman about the revenue process, and Sara about the tracker and on-call context. Reach out to each of them yourself.
DAY0: 4/7 — What should I read? Which documentation should I prioritise?
BOSS: Start with Team overview, Onboarding, Escalation paths and On-call rotation in Notion and the local documentation folder. Use the cited source, and say when the docs do not answer.
DAY0: 5/7 — Where does work live? Which tools hold formal work and informal asks?
BOSS: Formal work is in Linear tickets and the q4-revenue-tracker Google Sheet. Informal asks and manager approvals are in Slack. Team guidance is in Notion and the local docs folder.
DAY0: 6/7 — Anything immediate for week one?
BOSS: Read the priority docs, answer one bounded documented ask, and prepare exact ticket, sheet or Slack changes for approval. Do not publish or apply a write before I approve it.
DAY0: 7/7 — Anything else or any boundaries I should capture?
BOSS: Stay inside Revenue Operations. Do not make people or hiring decisions, do not publish anything public or marketing-facing, do not make destructive changes to a system of record, and never claim access to a system or quote a figure you have not read from a source. When a request needs access you do not have, or falls outside the team's remit, stop and escalate with the specific reason.
